title: Sound teams, blends and rhymes
titlePs: د غږونو ډلې، یوځای کول او قافیې
intro: Some spellings work as a team for one sound. In a blend, you can still hear both consonants. Compare the writing and listen to the sounds with an adult.
support: ځینې توري یو غږ ښيي. په ګډو بېلو غږونو کې دواړه غږونه اورېدل کېږي. لیکنه وګورئ او له مشر سره غږونه واورئ.
text:
ship · chin · thin · rain · feet · night
brush · sand · clock · sock · rock

A crab can swim. A fish can dash.
model: In ship, sh spells one sound. In brush, b and r spell two sounds. Sock and rock rhyme because the sounds from the vowel to the end match. In rain, feet and night, look for ai, ee and igh. Learn the spelling teams before reading the practice sentences.
activity: Sort ship, chin, thin and slip by the letters that spell the first sound. Keep sh, ch and th together.
adult: Say thin and chin without showing print. Ask the child whether the first sounds are alike. Then show the two spellings.
adultPs: thin او chin په لوړ غږ ووایئ، خو لیکنه مه ښکاره کوئ. له ماشومه د دواړو کلمو د لومړي غږ پوښتنه وکړئ.

tasks: Mark sh in ship and ch in chin. Read both to an adult.
Find the team in thin. Write the word and read it with help.
Circle the teams in rain and feet. Ask an adult to say each word.
Write night, then underline the three letters that work together.
Use an adult's model to write brush and sand from spoken sounds.
Find the part shared by clock, sock and rock. Say another rhyme.
Use your school's handwriting model to practise a join in sh. Tell what sounds you hear at the start of brush.
Read shop and slip. Mark the first sound spelling in shop and the first two sound spellings in slip.
Read: A crab can swim. A fish can dash. Circle the two separate letters for the first two sounds in crab. Then underline the sound team in fish.
Say two words that rhyme with rock. Write their shared spelling and explain.
